description: Applies a burst of edits without letting any background classification publish between them, then drains the dispatcher once. Every run except the last was started against a snapshot the buffer has since replaced. Most are cancelled before they finish and a few complete and are discarded; which of the two happens is a race, so the assertion is the invariant that holds either way — exactly one result is published, and it is the current snapshot. The deterministic rejection path is covered separately by the completed-stale-run-rejected check.
